name: Karunaivel
text: the training link expired b4 i could finish module 2, Karunaivel says a new one is coming tonite. can u nudge it plz

name: Dukelaj
text: the lockers by the changing room are getting new numbers next week so grab ur stuff b4 friday, Dukelaj has the list n a marker if u want to swap. the old stickers come off easy with a bit of heat

name: Lisanti Craß
text: the new coffee machine is finally in but nobody can find the water filter key, Lisanti Craß reckons its zip tied to the back of the unit. if u cut it pls leave the cable tidy, the last one got left dangling n the cleaner complained

name: Derschi Lazorczyk
text: the dvd player in the common room isnt reading discs, Derschi Lazorczyk tried a clean n it still skips. new one?

name: Luzius
text: the window in the quiet room wont shut properly n its freezing at night, Luzius put tape on it for now but we need a proper fix b4 winter. maintenance says the hinge is bent

name: Bakirtzis
text: the shared bikes are all out of service becos the tyres on all four keep going flat, Bakirtzis says the pump on the wall is broken n thats half the problem. a repair day is being planned for saturday. bring ur own pump if u have one n we can get four back on the road

name: Rina Shaira
text: the water cooler in the corridor is leaking again, Rina Shaira put a bucket under it n called the rental place.

name: De Valerio
text: the delivery driver dropped the boxes at the wrong unit again, De Valerio wheeled them over n signed for ours so nothing goes missing this time. the labels had our unit number so it was an easy fix

name: Dursun
text: the break room toaster tripped the power again this morning n took the kettle with it, Dursun reset the breaker n moved the toaster to the other bench. if it happens again its going in the bin. the kettle works fine on the far socket so its defo the toaster

name: Kahlert
text: the night light in the stairwell is out again, Kahlert swapped the bulb but it went pop straight away. new fitting is needed.

name: Kellermüller Amacker
text: the printer queue on the top floor is stuck on a job from yesterday, Kellermüller Amacker cleared the spool n its moving again but the job is lost. the sender will need to resend if its important

name: Rosamunda Dikici
text: the recycling bins got mixed up again after the swap day n now the paper one is full of cans, Rosamunda Dikici relabelled all four n put up a poster with pictures. fingers crossed it sticks this time. the bins by the back gate are next on the list

name: Modrusan
text: the shared umbrellas by the door have all vanished again, Modrusan found two in the meeting room tho. The rest are still missing.

name: Vinzenz
text: The storeroom inventory was finished a day early after the team split the aisles between them. Vinzenz counted the last bay and matched every line to the system. The report was sent to the office before closing.

name: Hasselbeck
text: The water leak under the sink was reported on Monday and a bucket was placed straight away. Hasselbeck traced it to the inlet washer and turned the valve off overnight. The plumber arrived on Wednesday and replaced both washers. The cupboard was dried out and the stock moved back.

name: Geisiane Uciu
text: The library trolley was found abandoned by the lifts and returned to the desk. Geisiane Uciu checked the books against the list.

name: von Minden
text: The gate duty was doubled for the open evening and the queue cleared within twenty minutes. von Minden briefed the two new marshals on the parking plan. Visitors were directed to the side field.

name: Niara
text: The choir risers were borrowed for the school concert and were stored in the hall overnight. Niara checked them back in on Friday and found one step scratched. The scratch was sanded out and the risers went back to the church. The hire fee was waived.

name: Tona
text: The logbook was found in the wrong cupboard and returned to the shed. Tona checked the last entries were intact.

name: Jaya Sithiresan
text: The paint tins were moved to the locked store after the yard was tidied. Jaya Sithiresan checked every lid was sealed before the store was locked for the night. The key was returned to the office hook.

name: Temür Essaïd Krkalovic
text: The cargo bikes were serviced as part of the green travel push and two were fitted with new locks. Temür Essaïd Krkalovic tested each bike on the yard loop before it went back on the rack. The old locks were recycled. Usage has doubled since the locks changed.

name: Sündüz
text: The bike shelter roof was cleared of leaves before the rain arrived. Sündüz swept the drain covers as well. The water runs clear now.

name: Svajger
text: The desk rota for the summer was posted a week early and the swap requests were all answered. Svajger covered the two gaps at the front desk personally. The final sheet went out on Friday.

name: Shyam Hermes
text: The training room was repainted over the weekend and the chairs were cleaned while the paint dried. Shyam Hermes checked the projector and the network point before the first session. Everything worked first time. The old posters were replaced. The room is booked out for the rest of the month.

name: Dine Doornaert
text: The tea point was restocked and the dishwasher was run on the empty cycle. Dine Doornaert wiped the counters. The fridge was checked too.

name: Koppmeier
text: The minibus was cleaned and the fuel topped up before the away trip. Koppmeier checked the tyre pressures and the first aid kit. The seats were wiped down at the depot.

name: Marie-Huguette
text: the quiz answer sheets are in the drawer by the till n the marker pens went missing again, weve got ten teams booked for friday n only one working bell. if u can grab pens on ur way in that would save a trip. cheers, Marie-Huguette

name: Triscari
text: the ping pong net is snapped n the balls are all flat, can u order a new set before thursday, Triscari

name: El Mahdaoui
text: the fern in the lobby keeps dropping leaves on the carpet n the hoover is full again, if anyone has five mins pls give it a once over, thanks, El Mahdaoui

name: Bulëza Eva
text: the spare chairs for the function room are in the corridor n they keep tripping ppl up, we need them stacked in the cupboard b4 saturday or the safety walk will flag it again. if u do it now it takes ten mins tops. the trolley is by the lift, Bulëza Eva

name: Eniola
text: the hand soap in the disabled loo has run out n the spare box is empty too, can someone grab some, thanks, Eniola

name: Blanc
text: the trolley coin jar is empty again so customers keep asking at the desk, i put a note out n raided the petty cash for ten coins, if more go missing well have to order, Blanc

name: Chalut Domeniconi
text: the folding tables came back from the fair with two bent legs n the hinges are gritty, we can fix them in the workshop if someone brings the drill bits over from the van, otherwise they sit in the corridor all week. the vice is free after lunch, Chalut Domeniconi

name: Drinor Imre
text: the label printer is chewing the rolls again n weve wasted half a box, someone have a look pls, Drinor Imre

name: Minh-Duc
text: the yoga mats are all stacked wet n they smell, can whoever ran the class hang them over the rail by the window, the next session is at six n wed like them dry by then, Minh-Duc

name: Pandele
text: the roof leak over the server corner is back after the storm n the bucket is overflowing, weve moved the cables n raised a job but the landlord wants photos from inside the ceiling void before friday. the access panel key is on the hook, Pandele

name: Shen Vieujean Abend
text: the folding screen in the clinic is torn n the frame wobbles, we need a new one ordered, Shen Vieujean Abend

name: Vasevski Sbrogio
text: the pool table cloth has a burn mark from the quiz night candles n the cues need new tips, if we sort it before the league match it saves a complaint, Vasevski Sbrogio

name: Al-Amin
text: The bus timetable for the school route was updated and the new times were posted at both stops. The driver confirmed the morning change with the office. The afternoon route stays the same. Nobody missed a stop, checked by Al-Amin. A copy went to the council transport team.

name: Ohl
text: The annual fire extinguisher check found one unit past its date and it was swapped the next morning, booked by Ohl.

name: Leguy Hintermayer
text: The garden waste collection was missed on Tuesday and the depot was called. A catch up lorry came on Thursday and the bins were emptied before the rain. The schedule was emailed to the residents, logged by Leguy Hintermayer.

name: Timeo Forrai
text: The new recycling rules were trialled for a fortnight and the contamination rate fell sharply. Glass and cardboard were separated at source for the first time. The trial results were shared with the county scheme. Extra bins were ordered for the summer season, signed by Timeo Forrai.

name: Najda
text: The hedge along the car park was trimmed back and the sight lines are clear again. Najda cleared the cuttings.

name: Mao
text: The parcel for the flat above the shop was signed for by mistake and held at the desk. The resident collected it the same evening. The courier was told to check the flat numbers, confirmed by Mao.

name: Letina Lestayo
text: The annual boiler inspection was brought forward and the engineer found the flue needed a new seal. The part was fitted the same visit and the readings were clean. A reminder for next year was set for the spring. The paperwork was filed by Letina Lestayo.

name: Syar Jan-Erik
text: The market stall fees were taken for June and the receipts were stapled to the sheet. The float was counted by Syar Jan-Erik.

name: Pallavi
text: The library overdue slips were printed and posted to the last known addresses. Returns picked up after the mailing and the shelf list was updated. The fines amnesty runs until Friday, recorded by Pallavi.

name: Mangiapia
text: The sports hall floor was resealed over the half term break and the lines were repainted to the league spec. The ventilation was serviced at the same time. Bookings reopened on Monday morning. A spare set stays in the office safe. The keys were handed back by Mangiapia.

name: Vanga Thavaneswary
text: The ticket scanner at the gate was swapped and the old unit was sent for repair. The barrier test passed, logged by Vanga Thavaneswary.

name: Nynke Arjanita
text: The seed order for the community garden was split with the school plot and both beds were planted on Saturday. Watering rota was pinned to the shed. The receipt was shared, countersigned by Nynke Arjanita.
